description_en: Queries the configuration of an access control list (ACL)
description_zh: 查询访问控制策略组的配置
kebab_example: aliyun slb describe-access-control-list-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id acl-bp1ut10zzvh1y8dfs0000 --acl-entry-comment test --page 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccessControlListAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the ACL.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401682.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略组的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ACL that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的访问控制策略组ID
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en: The remarks of the ACL entry
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组的条目的备注信息
parameters.name: acl_entry_comment

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：**50**。默认值：**10**
parameters.name: page_size
